name: Espathra
description: Espathra, the Ostrich Pokémon, and the evolved form of Flittle. A Psychic type.
pokedex_entries: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
